reason: Dropping $525 on one Reel from a creator whose follower counts and past results nobody has verified is a gamble I can't make on my budget, when I can put that same money into Meta ads and see ROAS within days. The promo code is nice, but it only tells me after the fact whether I wasted the money.
objection: The numbers are self-reported, so I have no way to know if a creator's audience actually buys, and on top of that I don't have time to brief creators and go back and forth approving drafts.
would_change_my_mind: Verified follower and sales data from past Collabo deals, like real promo-code redemptions per creator, plus cheaper starter packages around $100-150 so I can test one creator without risking a month of ad spend.
